plan.claim_under_test: Every algebraically independent connected block of the original frozen three-body Pauli ensemble with delta>0 admits a generator-by-generator independent Majorana-bilinear representation
plan.scope: Reuse only the 232 connected n<=6 graph records and their already-computed Rstar in phase2_results.json; do not resimulate stabilizer dynamics for graph classification
plan.classification: Exact edge partition into cliques with each graph vertex in at most two cliques. Enumerate all such partitions to decide existence of a simple root graph. Independently check root-edge incidence rank to decide whether any representation is algebraically independent (root forest).
controls_before_results: K3 is a line graph of a star tree
C4 is a line graph but its simple root has a cycle and dependent bilinears
plan.selection: Sort by n then original edge_bit_code. Select the first delta>0 graph without any line-graph root, if there is one; otherwise select the first delta>0 line graph lacking an independent root forest. Select at most ONE graph for geometric realization.
plan.interpretation: Failure of independent bilinear representation does not by itself exclude sectorwise free-fermion descriptions or establish novelty. An induced claw is a direct sufficient obstruction to any generator-by-generator bilinear representation, independently of the recognition implementation.
plan.geometric_realization: Only selected graph; L=n+4<=10, block anchors2..n+1, four guards0,1,L-2,L-1; no cross edges and guards have only edges(0,L-2),(0,L-1). Fix every first letter X; set third letter X/Y by the distance-two target edge. Solve middle letters with an exact three-state cyclic transfer constraint. Choose lexicographically first feasible middle-letter sequence, no outcome-based selection. If none exists, report failure and stop, do not try a second graph or change target.
plan.physical_validation_if_feasible: Freeze explicit words and predicted a/Rstar before enumeration. Verify graph and full GF2 rank; enumerate physical reachable unsigned groups up to20000 states and compare additive Rstar with stored block result. Check all signed-engine/Stim branches of only the maximum-rank witness, at most128 branches.
plan.literature: Read at most three directly relevant primary papers; prioritize Chapman2022, Ippoliti2021 and existing Majorana2023, distinguish line-graph obstruction from standard non-Gaussian measurement theory. No lack-of-search-hit novelty claim.
plan.stop: After this one coverage test. If only a known non-Gaussian example or routine count improvement is obtained, with no nontrivial capacity theorem or physical quantitative advance, pause the frozen-endpoint SCI branch instead of adding graph sizes or production.
plan.preserve: Old reports, raw data, code, tests, failed conjectures and frozen plans remain unchanged. Save round2 handoff snapshot before updating active MASTER/progress. No parameter scans, QPU/account access, subagents or manuscript drafting.
